hints.title: Bitwise Discrepancy Operator
hints.text: The bitwise exclusive-or operation (start ^ goal) produces a 1 bit precisely at positions where start and goal differ.

hints.title: Hamming Weight
hints.text: The minimum number of bit flips equals the population count (number of set bits) of start ^ goal.

hints.title: Kernighan Bit Clearing
hints.text: Clearing the lowest set bit with x = x & (x - 1) counts set bits in time proportional to the number of flips.

hints.title: Bitwise Population Count

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to manual padded binary arrays incurs unnecessary overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies XOR and Hamming weight directly.
